answer: Bindings are kept in beacon, verified in thread, and the chain is public. Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 4 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the haven check. A farm generating text without memory of its own history thus fails the binding, thus it has to store and read state per alias. A farm of 4486 identities would post 4692 proofs and burn roughly 81 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
